name: Jour Tempo: Tempo colour of today and tomorrow (RTE data, free API, no key)
info:
Reads https://jourtempo.fr/api/v1/tempo.json every 30 minutes (never more often than every 10 minutes).

- Output 1 of the function: `msg.payload.today` / `msg.payload.tomorrow` = `bleu`, `blanc`, `rouge` (tomorrow can be `inconnu` before RTE's announcement, around 10:30).
- Output 2: no usable data (no answer yet, error, or data past `perime_apres`): colours are `inconnu`, never guessed.
- If a request fails, the last good answer is used until it expires (`from_cache: true`).

Credit when displaying the colours publicly: "Couleurs Tempo : RTE, via Jour Tempo" with a link to https://jourtempo.fr

Documentation and terms: https://jourtempo.fr/api/
